title: L'Occitane enters longevity with ‘new approach’ to ageing inspired by 25 years of research
summary: L’Occitane’s Skin Longevity By Nature approach introduces a new four-step ‘ritual’ featuring the French skin and body care brand’s new Immortelle Divine Targeted Wrinkle Care
